messages:
lee_support: heads-up to CS: Onboardly (trial) seeing sustained 429s + some 503 spikes on embeddings during their onboarding run. Customer says this blocks finishing integration tests before trial expires. Marked P1.

lee_support: repro notes: single-run job ~2k docs via sync-api, client retried on 429 which amplified errors. Sample error: `HTTP 429 {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":120}` and occasional `HTTP 503 Service Unavailable`.

sam_cs: Thanks. Who is the day-0 contact? Onboardly lead is eva@onboardly.io, trial ends 2026-05-12. Renewal touchpoint in June. We should offer a short-term quota bump + call.

lee_support: No deploys reported. Monitoring shows sudden concurrency bump coinciding with their job start. Logs: `[2026-05-08T08:04:12Z] limiter INFO tenant=onboardly tokens=exhausted
[2026-05-08T08:04:13Z] router WARN response=backpressure_active`

raj_eng: I can look at tenant rate-limits and autoscaler behavior. Auto-scaler logs show pods spun up but throttling at gateway layer. Possible mis-synced quota for trial tenants, or conservative per-tenant gating.

autoscale-bot: autoscaler: scaled embed-cluster from 4->8 nodes at 2026-05-08T08:05Z due to CPU pressure. No errors during scale event.

monitoring-bot: alert: tenant_errors(onboardly) > 5% over 10m at 2026-05-08T08:06Z. Paging if >10% sustained.

sam_cs: Proposed immediate customer comms: "We're investigating intermittent rate limiting affecting your onboarding run. Temporary mitigation: limit client concurrency to 3 and use async batch endpoint; we can also provide a temporary quota bump while we diagnose. We'll follow up with a technical RCA within 48 hours." Agree? :white_check_mark:

lee_support: Agree. Add exact client example for them: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/async -d @batch.json -H \"Authorization: Bearer <key>\"` and advise `--concurrency 3`. Also suggest exponential backoff with jitter.

raj_eng: I can do a quick tenant-level quota audit. If quota was set incorrectly for trials there's a propensity to hit gateway limits. ETA 3h for audit and a hotfix if needed. If safe, we can apply a temporary quota bump to this tenant for 24h.

sam_cs: I'll schedule a 20-min bridge with Eva for 2026-05-08 09:30 PT. Need someone from eng for the call (raj?) and support (lee). Also want an email template we can send immediately.

lee_support: Draft email to customer: "Hi Eva — we see your onboarding job triggered automated rate limits. Temporary workaround: switch to the async batch endpoint and set concurrency=3. We can apply a one-time quota increase so your job completes. We will join a short call to walk through this now."

raj_eng: Audit result: trial tenants had quota ceiling set to 75 req/min due to legacy config. Onboardly's job needed ~220 req/min at peak. I can bump this tenant to 300 req/min for 24h. Making change now and monitoring.

autoscale-bot: action: applied tenant_quota=300 to tenant=onboardly at 2026-05-08T08:21Z by raj_eng (temporary 24h).

lee_support: Update for thread: After quota bump and guidance to use async endpoint + concurrency=3, Onboardly resumed and completed 80% of their job; they still have some retries but overall much better. Customer awaiting assurance before finishing tests.

sam_cs: Good. Next steps: 1) Send post-call summary and runbook for async uploads (sam_cs) due 1h, 2) eng to document quota fix and review trial defaults (raj_eng) due 48h, 3) CSM to log renewal risk note and offer concierge onboarding if needed (tanya_csm) due EOD.

tanya_csm: I'll add a renewal-protection note to their record and offer a one-week extended trial if they request — helps mitigate risk.

raj_eng: Root cause hypothesis: legacy trial quota + client retry storm causing gateway queue saturation. Long-term fixes: adjust trial quota defaults, add smoother token bucket behavior, and add clearer limits in onboarding docs. I'll post a short RCA to this thread within 48h.

monitoring-bot: alert cleared at 2026-05-08T08:45Z (tenant_errors(onboardly) < 1% over 10m).

sam_cs: Customer call summary: Eva appreciated quick action and accepted temporary quota bump. She requested written steps and a follow-up check-in after the quota window. Schedule post-mitigation check for 2026-05-09 10:00 PT.

lee_support: Action owners recap: send runbook (sam_cs), finalize RCA + trial-defaults plan (raj_eng), update customer record + offer extension (tanya_csm), monitor metrics for 24h (monitoring-bot/raj_eng). Keep updates short in this thread.

raj_eng: Noted. I'll include suggested telemetry changes to detect retry storms earlier.

sam_cs: Thanks team — great cross-functional response. I'll close the immediate bridge once the customer confirms job completion and we have the RCA draft.
